title: Work lettering in deliberate passes
principle: Custom lettering quality comes from staged passes—skeleton, weight, contrast, then flourish—not from polishing a weak skeleton.
procedure: Pass 2: weight and contrast consistency across letters.
Pass 4: flourishes only where structure already sings.
Stop when decoration starts hiding structure problems.
examplePrompts:
Critique this lettering in passes.

1) Skeleton issues
2) Weight/contrast issues
3) Optical spacing
4) Flourish keep/kill
Do not add ornament until structure passes.
tips: Hische’s public teaching emphasizes process and craft of letterforms.
